title_original: Constance Wu, Macaulay Culkin, Ken Leung And Ethan Eng To Star In New A24 Film From Director Walter Woodman

blocks.text: EXCLUSIVE: A24 has assembled an all-star ensemble for Walter Woodman ‘s directorial debut as the studio has set Constance Wu , Macaulay Culkin , Ken Leung, Veronika Slowikowska, David Klein and Ethan Eng to join the untitled directorial debut of Woodman. The film will be produced by Shy Kids, Pressman Film, Esmail Corp. and A24 with Wooodman directing.

Co-written by shy kids’ Woodman, Gregory Calderone, Patrick Cederberg, Sidney Leeder and Alexander Weinstein, the film is a coming-of-age story set against the birth of the internet. Sam Esmail, Chad Hamilton and Nick Krishnamurthy will produce through Esmail Corp, alongside Sam Pressman and Max Loeb for Pressman Film, Sidney Leeder for shy kids, Zach Vargas-Sullivan and A24.
Executive Producers include Bianca Rusu and Paula Paizes of Pressman, Patrick Cederberg of shy kids and Dan Bekerman. Weinstein and Jack Masterson will also serve as executive producers.

Culkin is represented by CAA and Untitled, Wu is represented at Gersh, Principal Entertainment and Hansen, Jacobson, Teller. Leung is represented by Paradigm Talent Agency and Brillstein Entertainment Partners Slowikowska is represented by UTA, Artists First, and Yorn Levine. Klein is represented by Play Management, Untitled Entertainment, and Lichter, Grossman, Nichols. Eng is represented by Gersh.
